name: reset-radar
description: Independent public AI reset monitoring — local Worker foundation

scripts.pretypes: node --input-type=module -e "import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'; mkdirSync('.wrangler/types', { recursive: true });"
scripts.typecheck: npm run types && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test:d1: vitest run tests/stage4-storage.test.ts tests/stage4-ingest.test.ts tests/stage5-storage.test.ts tests/stage5-publish.test.ts tests/stage6-runtime.test.ts
scripts.d1:migrate:local: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/ WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler d1 migrations apply reset-radar-stage4-test --config wrangler.d1.local.json --local --persist-to .wrangler/stage4-d1
